title: Juicy Molten Uruguayan Chocolate Tart
description: A diabetic friendly dessert featuring herbes de provence and tempered chocolate, this uruguayan tart is a floral and molten treat. It combines the richness of chocolate with the subtlety of herbs.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a double boiler, melt the dark chocolate, stirring occasionally.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond flour, herbes de provence, and salt.
Add the melted butter, eggs, granulated sweetener, and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a tart pan with a removable bottom.
Pour the melted chocolate into the center of the tart, creating a molten center.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is still slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
